description: Use this when someone asks what they should do next to show up in AI answers. Returns CueScout's To-dos for the brand in priority order: the action, why it matters and its priority. Filter by status: todo (default), suggested, done or dismissed.

brand.description: Which brand, by name or id, when the account tracks more than one. Leave empty to use the only brand; list_brands shows them all.

title: List the brand's To-dos
